title: Stop on a Validation Plateau
instructions:
Fit the supplied model on trainX/trainY for at most 500 epochs with validationSplit 0.2 and a batch size from 8 to 64 (default 32). Implement makeEarlyStopping() returning tf.callbacks.earlyStopping({ monitor: 'val_loss', patience: 5, minDelta: 0 }), and attach it to the fit. Store the awaited result in history. A correct run can stop early or reach its epoch limit; neither outcome proves a defect.

Implement diagnose(trainLosses, valLosses) for equally long arrays of finite, nonnegative losses. Reject invalid arrays. With fewer than 20 entries, return 'insufficient-history'. Otherwise compare the mean of each curve's last ten entries with its previous ten. A drop greater than 5% is improvement; a rise greater than 5% is worsening. Exactly 5% lies in the flat band. Compare by multiplication so an earlier mean of zero is handled without division: zero to positive is worsening, zero to zero is flat.

Apply this order: validation improving -> 'validation-improving'; both curves worsening -> 'both-worsening'; training improving while validation worsens -> 'train-down-validation-up'; any other validation worsening -> 'validation-worsening'; otherwise -> 'plateau'. These labels describe recent trends. They do not establish overfitting, data shift or a learning-rate problem; investigate those possibilities using data and further experiments.

Allow an absolute 1e-12 comparison tolerance for floating-point arithmetic at the 5% boundaries.

title: Train DEEP SCAN, Then Read the Gap
instructions:
The supplied tensors contain 100 synthetic training rows and 43 separate
evaluation rows: 40 generated examples and three hand-written story cases.
Keep the evaluation rows and their labels out of training.

1. Await model.fit(trainX, trainY, { epochs: 30, batchSize: 16 }) into history.
2. Store model.evaluate(testX, testY) in evalResult, an array [loss, accuracy].
3. Implement diagnose(trainAcc, testAcc): return 'large-gap' if trainAcc -
   testAcc > 0.15; otherwise 'low-scores' if both are below 0.7; otherwise
   'no-gap-warning'. Check the gap first. These labels do not diagnose a cause.
4. Set trainAcc from the final history.history.acc entry and testAcc from
   evalResult[1].dataSync()[0]. Set verdict = diagnose(trainAcc, testAcc).

Report the measured scores. Passing verifies the exercise procedure, not
whether the classifier is suitable for a real deployment.
